About this item

  • Runs Large
  • Mesh upper.
  • Rearfoot GEL technology: Shock-attenuating material placed in the midsole of the shoe for cushioning and shock absorption.
  • AMPLIFOAM PLUS cushioning: Midsole cushioning that provides a more soft and comfortable ride than standard AMPLIFOAM.
  • OrthoLite Hybrid Max Lite sockliner: Designed to help provide advanced moisture management, breathability, and cushioning properties. Molded rubber outsole.
  • Molded rubber outsole.: The sockliner is produced with the solution dyeing process that reduces water usage by approximately 33% and carbon emissions by approximately 45% compared to the conventional dyeing technology.:

Product Description

The ASICS GEL-VENTURE 11 shoe is designed to help provide good comfort for daily wear. AMPLIFOAM PLUS cushioning in the midsole is reinforced by a 2mm higher stack height. These updates help you experience better impact absorption and more comfort throughout the day. The upper is also modified with no-sew details for a more comfortable fit. Crafted from polyester upper, lining, and insole, this pair of shoes features round toe, lace-up closure, and classic design. Low top silhouette. Synthetic rubber outsole.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find these running shoes comfortable, with one mentioning their heel pain is gone, and appreciate their quality and arch support, with one noting excellent support for running on any surface. They receive positive feedback for their appearance and versatility, being great for walking all day and active lifestyles. The durability and cushioning receive mixed reviews - while some say they last forever, others report they don't hold up over time, and while some praise the cushioning, others say there's no cushioning at all. Value for money opinions are also mixed, with some saying they're worth the money while others disagree.

About this Item

  • Runs Large
  • Mesh upper.
  • Rearfoot GEL technology: Shock-attenuating material placed in the midsole of the shoe for cushioning and shock absorption.
  • AMPLIFOAM PLUS cushioning: Midsole cushioning that provides a more soft and comfortable ride than standard AMPLIFOAM.
  • OrthoLite Hybrid Max Lite sockliner: Designed to help provide advanced moisture management, breathability, and cushioning properties. Molded rubber outsole.
  • Molded rubber outsole.: The sockliner is produced with the solution dyeing process that reduces water usage by approximately 33% and carbon emissions by approximately 45% compared to the conventional dyeing technology.:

Product Description

The ASICS GEL-VENTURE 11 shoe is designed to help provide good comfort for daily wear. AMPLIFOAM PLUS cushioning in the midsole is reinforced by a 2mm higher stack height. These updates help you experience better impact absorption and more comfort throughout the day. The upper is also modified with no-sew details for a more comfortable fit. Crafted from polyester upper, lining, and insole, this pair of shoes features round toe, lace-up closure, and classic design. Low top silhouette. Synthetic rubber outsole.
